scope: Targeted official Fair Work Commission search for post-merits implementation, appeal stay, interim payment, and later appeal outcome.

sources_reviewed.result: Deactivation found unfair; reactivation ordered within 7 days; lost remuneration ordered in principle with quantum to be determined.
16 June 2026 consent stay pending appeal; Rasier conditioned to pay $259.38 per week from 28 May 2026 and not seek repayment of those interim payments.
Located the merits decision and appeal stay order; no later public appeal determination or final quantum/payment-receipt record located in the returned Waheed results.

boundary: An interim payment obligation is stronger than an unquantified entitlement but is not evidence of payment receipt. A stay condition and reactivation order do not establish actual account access, final lost-pay quantum, continued work, or durable recovery.
storage_boundary: Only official decision metadata, URLs, hashes, stage statuses, and bounded search results are stored; no personal exhibits or bulk case-file material is retained.
